	funcOnErrorMsg("役付回付_Click",Err, Erl, Error$), 16, "システムエラー"

		doc.SaveOptions = "0"
		Call uidoc.Close( False )

Sub Click(Source As Button)
	On Error Goto ERR_TRAP
	Dim ws						As NotesUIWorkspace
	Dim uidoc					As NotesUIDocument
	Dim doc					As NotesDocument
	Dim varStatusRet			As Variant
	Dim varDummyAry			As Variant
	Dim varStatusCodeAry		As Variant
	Dim varStatusAry			As Variant
	Dim varSelectStatus 		As Variant
	Dim varSelectCodeIndex 	As Variant
	Dim strRetMsg				As String
	Dim strSetStatusCode		As String
	Dim intRes					As Integer
	Dim intStatusCode 		As Integer
	Dim intGetCode 			As Integer
	Set ws			= New NotesUIWorkspace
	Set uidoc		= ws.CurrentDocument
	Set doc			= uidoc.Document
	intStatusCode = 1000
	varStatusRet = funcWfStatGet( Cstr(intStatusCode), 0 )
	varStatusCodeAry = Split(varStatusRet(0))
	varStatusAry = Split(varStatusRet(1))
	intGetCode = Cint(doc.StatusCode(0))
	If (doc.SaiFlag(0) = "") Or (intGetCode = 6000) Then
	Else
		intGetCode = 7000
	End If
	Do While intGetCode > intStatusCode
		varStatusRet = funcWfStatGet( Cstr(intStatusCode), 1 )
		If intGetCode > Cint(varStatusRet(0)) Then
			varStatusCodeAry = Arrayappend(varStatusCodeAry, Split(varStatusRet(0)) )
			varStatusAry = Arrayappend(varStatusAry, Split(varStatusRet(1)) )

Sub Click(Source As Button)
	On Error Goto ERR_TRAP
	Dim ws				As NotesUIWorkspace
	Dim uidoc			As NotesUIDocument
	Dim doc			As NotesDocument
	Dim strStatusCode	As String
	Dim strRetMsg		As String
	Dim blnSEM		As Boolean
	Dim blnRes			As Boolean
	Dim intRes			As Integer
	Dim varStatusRet	As Variant
	strRetMsg = funcReturnMsg( "Q001" )
	intRes = Msgbox( strRetMsg, 4 + 32 + 256, "確認" )
	If intRes = 7 Then
		strRetMsg = funcReturnMsg( "I001" )
		Msgbox strRetMsg, 0 + 64,"確認"
		Exit Sub
	Else
	End If
	Set ws			= New NotesUIWorkspace
	Set uidoc		= ws.CurrentDocument
	Set doc			= uidoc.Document
	If funcChangeDocMode(uidoc, True) = False Then
		Exit Sub
	Else
	End If
	doc.BtnFlag = "1"
	If funcBirthField( uidoc ) = False Then
		doc.BtnFlag = "0"
		Exit Sub
	End If
	blnSEM = funcErrChkDan( uidoc )
	If blnSEM = False Then
		doc.BtnFlag = "0"
		Exit Sub
	Else
	End If
	blnRes = funcChkDocSize( doc, 300 )
	If blnRes = False Then
		doc.BtnFlag = "0"
		Call uidoc.GotoField("AttatchDoc1")
		strRetMsg = funcReturnMsg("E010")
		Msgbox strRetMsg, 0 + 16,"エラー"
		Exit Sub
	Else
	End If
	strStatusCode = doc.StatusCode(0)
	varStatusRet = funcWfStatGet( strStatusCode, 1 )
	If varStatusRet(0) = "" Then
		doc.BtnFlag = "0"
		strRetMsg = funcReturnMsg( "E021" )
		Msgbox strRetMsg, 0 + 16, "エラー"
		Exit Sub
	End If
	doc.StatusCode = varStatusRet(0)
	doc.StatusName = varStatusRet(1)
	blnSEM = funcUpdateRireki( doc, varStatusRet(0) )
	If blnSEM = False Then
		doc.SaveOptions = "0"
		Call uidoc.Close( False )
		Exit Sub
	Else
	End If
	If funcSaveConflictCheck(doc) = False Then
		doc.SaveOptions = "0"
	Else
		doc.SaveOptions = "1"
		Call uidoc.Save
	End If
	Call uidoc.Close( False )
	Exit Sub
ERR_TRAP:
	strRetMsg = funcReturnMsg( "E020" )
	Msgbox strRetMsg & Chr(13) & Chr(10) & Chr(13) & Chr(10) & _
	funcOnErrorMsg("役付回付_Click",Err, Erl, Error$), 16, "システムエラー"
	If doc Is Nothing Then
	Else
		doc.SaveOptions = "0"
		Call uidoc.Close( False )
	End If
	Exit Sub
End Sub
